sql:
select sum(cs_ext_discount_amt) from catalog_sales,item,date_dim
where i_manufact_id=100 and i_item_sk=cs_item_sk and d_date between '2000-01-01' and '2000-04-01' and d_date_sk=cs_sold_date_sk
and cs_ext_discount_amt>(select 1.3*avg(cs_ext_discount_amt) from catalog_sales,date_dim where cs_item_sk=i_item_sk and d_date between '2000-01-01' and '2000-04-01' and d_date_sk=cs_sold_date_sk) limit 100
